r.경제 체제: Specialized manufacturing and finance · uses the Swiss franc
r.정치 구도: A constitutional monarchy in which the prince holds broad powers.

t.why: It uses the Swiss franc and is in a customs union with Switzerland.
t.rel: A small principality between Switzerland and Austria. It entrusts some foreign affairs and border control to Switzerland, and through the European Economic Area it is linked to the EU single market.
t.know: Small as it is, it is a financial center where many foundations and trusts are registered.
t.etext: Strong in specialized manufacturing such as precision machinery, dental materials and tools, and in finance, giving it one of the highest incomes per person in the world. It uses the Swiss franc.
